content: Which QC warnings does the latest ZETA run have?
QC of ZETA: pass_with_warnings, 5 flag(s), run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

The latest ZETA run (run 19ac527c, pipeline v0.1.0) has QC status **pass_with_warnings**. It has 0 errors, 5 warnings and 10 info flags.

The five warnings:

| Code | Structure | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| MESH_VOLUME_MISMATCH | Stapes | Mesh volume differs from voxel volume by 3.2% (threshold 0.02, i.e. 2%). |
| MESH_VOLUME_MISMATCH | Chorda Tympani | Mesh volume differs from voxel volume by 4.3% (threshold 2%). |
| AREA_METHOD_SENSITIVE | Stapes | Surface area differs from Slicer by +15.3%. The flag notes that thin structures depend on smoothing (threshold 10%). |
| AREA_METHOD_SENSITIVE | Chorda Tympani | Surface area differs from Slicer by +12.1%, with the same smoothing note (threshold 10%). |
| OUT_OF_PUBLISHED_RANGE | Cochlea | Height is 4.36 mm, outside the published range of 2.8–3.72 mm (36 ears, HRCT, ages 2–17; source Zahara2019). |

The Stapes and Chorda Tympani warnings are about thin structures, where the volume and area values depend on the method used. The cochlear height flag compares one specimen against a published paediatric range, so it doesn't by itself show an error in the measurement. I can look up what the documentation says about these flags if you'd like.
